spans.text: Kowane mutum yana da ƴanci, a cikakken daidaici, da kotu mai ƴancin kanta da rishin nuna son rai ta saurari kukanshi yadda ya kamata kuma a gaban jama’a, wanda za ta yanke hukunci, ko hakkinshi da abubuwa da suka wajabta gare shi, ko da gaskiyar tuhumar da aka yi mishi.
Kowane mutum na da ƴanci doka ta kare shi game da dukkan shiga- shugula ko wannan taɓa hakki.
Kowane mutum yana da ƴancin yawo yadda ya buƙata kuma ya zaɓi mazauninshi a cikin ƙasa.
Kowane mutum yana da ƴanci barin kowace ƙasa, har ma da tashi, kuma ya dawo cikinta
Game da tsanani muzgunawa, kowane mutum yana da ƴancin neman mafaka da kuma samun mafaka a cikin wasu ƙasashe.
Kowane mutum yana da ƴancin samun takardar shaidar cika ɗan ƙasa
Iyali shine ginshiƙin al’umma mahi muhummanci kuma yana da ƴancin samun kariya daga al’umma da ƙasa.
Mutum ya zamana shi kaɗai ko tare da jama’a, yana da ƴancin samun mazaumi.

Kowane mutum yana da ƴancin yin nazari, da sanin ciwon kai da addini; wannan hakki na bada ƴancin canza addini ko na tabbaci da kuma ƴancin nuna addininshi ko tabbacinshi, shi kaɗai ko tare da jama’a, cikin bainar jama’a ko a keɓance, ta hanyar koyarwa, tabi’o’i, bautawa wani abu da aikata ibadodi.

Kowane mutum yana da ƴancin yin shawara da ƴancin kafa ƙungiya cikin kwanciyar hankali.
Kowane mutum yana da ƴancin halarta wajen gabartar da ayyukan jama’a na ƙasarshi, kai tsaye, ko kuma ta hanyar wani wakili da ya zaɓa.

spans.text: Kowane mutum yana da ƴancin ra’ayi da na magantawa, wannan ne ke ba shi ƴancin rishin damuwa game da ra’ayoyinshi da na neman labaru da ra’ayi, na samunsu da kuma na yaɗasu, ba tare da kula da iyakoki ba, ta kowace hanyar magantawa.

folded.id: na tabbaci|da|kuma ƴancin nuna addininshi ko tabbacinshi
folded.subject: na tabbaci
folded.object: kuma ƴancin nuna addininshi ko tabbacinshi

spans.text: Kowane mutum yana da ƴancin yin nazari, da sanin ciwon kai da addini; wannan hakki na bada ƴancin canza addini ko na tabbaci da kuma ƴancin nuna addininshi ko tabbacinshi, shi kaɗai ko tare da jama’a, cikin bainar jama’a ko a keɓance, ta hanyar koyarwa, tabi’o’i, bautawa wani abu da aikata ibadodi.

folded.id: namiji|da|mace
folded.subject: namiji
folded.object: mace

spans.text: Daga an kai shekarar aure (balaga), namiji da mace, kada a tauye wani abu dangane da ƙabila, shaidar cika ɗan ƙasa ko addini, suna da ƴancin su yi aure kuma su kafa iyali, ƴancinsu ya daidaita bisa abun da ya shafi aure, cikin zaman aure da lokacin rabuwarshi.

folded.id: su rabu|da|tsoro da bala’i
folded.subject: su rabu
folded.object: tsoro da bala’i

spans.text: Ganin cewa ƙin amincewa da rena hakkin ɗan Adam sune suka haddasa aikin assha da tada ƙayar bayan lamarin bil Adama da kuma cewa shigowar sabon al’amari na duniya inda mutane za su samu ƴancin magana da tunani, su rabu da tsoro da bala’i, shine aka bayyana kamar babban kishin zucin ɗan Adam,

folded.id: suna|da|hankali da kima da natsuwa kuma ya kamata su haɗa kansu
folded.subject: Suna
folded.object: hankali da kima da natsuwa kuma ya kamata su haɗa kansu

spans.text: Suna da hankali da kima da natsuwa kuma ya kamata su haɗa kansu.

Daga an kai shekarar aure (balaga), namiji da mace, kada a tauye wani abu dangane da ƙabila, shaidar cika ɗan ƙasa ko addini, suna da ƴancin su yi aure kuma su kafa iyali, ƴancinsu ya daidaita bisa abun da ya shafi aure, cikin zaman aure da lokacin rabuwarshi.

folded.id: tashi tsaye|a|kai don fifita ci gaban al’umma da kafa datattun halayen rayuwa cikin wadataccen ƴanci
folded.subject: tashi tsaye
folded.object: kai don fifita ci gaban al’umma da kafa datattun halayen rayuwa cikin wadataccen ƴanci

spans.text: Ganin cewa cikin usula, al’ummomin ƙasashen ɗinkin duniya sun bayyana hal wa yau imaninsu ga cikakkun tsare-tsaren shari’ar ɗan Adam, cikin mutunci da darajar mutum, cikin daidaicin hakkin maza da mata, kuma suka bayyana tashi tsaye a kai don fifita ci gaban al’umma da kafa datattun halayen rayuwa cikin wadataccen ƴanci,

folded.id: waɗanda suke|da|wannan kalamin a cikin tunanisu na ko da yaushe
folded.subject: waɗanda suke
folded.object: wannan kalamin a cikin tunanisu na ko da yaushe

spans.text: Yana bayyana wannan kalamin duniya gaba ɗaya na kare hakkin ɗan Adam tamkar aƙidar da duk al’ummomi da duk ƙasashe ya kamata su cimma domin dukkan mutane da dukkan ƙungiyoyin al’umma, waɗanda suke da wannan kalamin a cikin tunanisu na ko da yaushe, su dage, da koyarwa da bada ilimi da horo, don tabbatar da biyayya ga waɗannan hakkoki da ƴanci a kuma tabbartar da, game da matakan ci gaba na tsarin cikin ƙasa da ƙasashe, cikakkar yarda da cikakken aiki na duniya baki ɗaya, ko ya kasance daga cikin jama’ar ƙasashe mambobi su da kansu ko kuma ya kasance cikin jama’ar yankunan da aka sa ƙarƙashin ikonsu.

folded.id: waɗanda|a|lokacin da ya akaita su
folded.subject: waɗanda
folded.object: lokacin da ya akaita su

spans.text: Ba wanda za a sa kaso saboda aikata ayyuka ko mantuwa, waɗanda a lokacin da ya akaita su, ba su kasance laifi ba a cikin tsarin shari’a na ƙasa ko na ƙasashen duniya.

folded.id: waɗannan hakkoki|da|ƴanci shi ne mahi muhimmanci don cika wannan nauyin
folded.subject: waɗannan hakkoki
folded.object: ƴanci shi ne mahi muhimmanci don cika wannan nauyin

spans.text: Ganin cewa samun manufa ɗaya na waɗannan hakkoki da ƴanci shi ne mahi muhimmanci don cika wannan nauyin,

folded.id: wanda za|a|azabatar
folded.subject: wanda za
folded.object: azabatar

spans.text: Ba wanda za a azabatar, ko muzguna ko dukan rishin imani, ko mai taɓarɓare jiki.

folded.id: wanda za|a|ɗauka da sunan bauta ko aikin badala
folded.subject: wanda za
folded.object: ɗauka da sunan bauta ko aikin badala

spans.text: Ba wanda za a ɗauka da sunan bauta ko aikin badala; an hana kowaɗane irin siffofin bauta ko fataucin bayu

folded.id: wanda za|a|kama ba tare da hujja ba
folded.subject: wanda za
folded.object: kama ba tare da hujja ba

spans.text: Ba wanda za a kama ba tare da hujja ba, ɗan kaso ko ɗan gudun hijira.
Ba wanda za a hana ma takardarshi ta shaidar cika ɗan ƙasa ba da wata hujja ba, ko a hana shi ƴancin canza takardarshi ta shaida.
Ba wanda za a raba da mazauninshi ba tare da wata hujja ba.

folded.id: wanda za|a|sa kaso saboda aikata ayyuka ko mantuwa
folded.subject: wanda za
folded.object: sa kaso saboda aikata ayyuka ko mantuwa

spans.text: Ba wanda za a sa kaso saboda aikata ayyuka ko mantuwa, waɗanda a lokacin da ya akaita su, ba su kasance laifi ba a cikin tsarin shari’a na ƙasa ko na ƙasashen duniya.

folded.id: wanda za|a|yi ma shiga-shugula na ba dalili a cikin rayuwarshi
folded.subject: wanda za
folded.object: yi ma shiga-shugula na ba dalili a cikin rayuwarshi

spans.text: Ba wanda za a yi ma shiga-shugula na ba dalili a cikin rayuwarshi, iyalinshi, gidanshi ko alaƙarshi, ko taɓa mutuncinshi ko sunanshi.
Ba wanda za a tilasta ma shiga wata ƙungiya.

folded.id: wani abu|da|aikata ibadodi
folded.subject: wani abu
folded.object: aikata ibadodi

spans.text: Kowane mutum yana da ƴancin yin nazari, da sanin ciwon kai da addini; wannan hakki na bada ƴancin canza addini ko na tabbaci da kuma ƴancin nuna addininshi ko tabbacinshi, shi kaɗai ko tare da jama’a, cikin bainar jama’a ko a keɓance, ta hanyar koyarwa, tabi’o’i, bautawa wani abu da aikata ibadodi.

folded.id: wani wakili|da|ya zaɓa
folded.subject: wani wakili
folded.object: ya zaɓa

spans.text: Kowane mutum yana da ƴancin halarta wajen gabartar da ayyukan jama’a na ƙasarshi, kai tsaye, ko kuma ta hanyar wani wakili da ya zaɓa.

folded.id: ya kamata|a|bayyana wannan niyya ta hanyar zaɓuɓɓuka na gaskiya waɗanda za a yi su lokaci zuwa lokaci
folded.subject: ya kamata
folded.object: bayyana wannan niyya ta hanyar zaɓuɓɓuka na gaskiya waɗanda za a yi su lokaci zuwa lokaci

spans.text: Niyyar jama’a ita ce ginshiƙin ikon hukumominta; ya kamata a bayyana wannan niyya ta hanyar zaɓuɓɓuka na gaskiya waɗanda za a yi su lokaci zuwa lokaci, ga zaɓen da ya shafi kowa da kowa da zaɓe cikin sirri ko ga ɗaukan matakin da zai tabbatar da ƴancin

folded.id: ya muhimminta|a|bada ƙwarin gwiwa ga ci gaban dangantaka tsakanin ƙasashe
folded.subject: ya muhimminta
folded.object: bada ƙwarin gwiwa ga ci gaban dangantaka tsakanin ƙasashe

spans.text: Ganin cewa ya muhimminta a bada ƙwarin gwiwa ga ci gaban dangantaka tsakanin ƙasashe,

folded.id: ya na|da|ƴancin a karɓe shi a matsayinshi na ɗan adam a ko’ina
folded.subject: ya na
folded.object: ƴancin a karɓe shi a matsayinshi na ɗan Adam a ko’ina

spans.text: kowa ya na da ƴancin a karɓe shi a matsayinshi na ɗan Adam a ko’ina

folded.subject: ya na

spans.text: Kowane mutum ya na da ƴancin ɗaukaka ƙara gaban ƙwararrin hukumomin ƙasa game da ayyuka masu karya muhimman hakkokinshi waɗanda tsarin mulki da doka suka amince da su.

folded.subject: ya na
folded.object: ƴancin rayuwa

spans.text: Kowane mutum ya na da ƴancin rayuwa, da ƴancin walawa da kuma kwanciyar kankalin kanshi

folded.subject: ƴancin walawa
folded.object: kuma kwanciyar kankalin kanshi

spans.text: Kowane mutum ya na da ƴancin rayuwa, da ƴancin walawa da kuma kwanciyar kankalin kanshi

Kowane mutum yana da ƴanci, a cikakken daidaici, da kotu mai ƴancin kanta da rishin nuna son rai ta saurari kukanshi yadda ya kamata kuma a gaban jama’a, wanda za ta yanke hukunci, ko hakkinshi da abubuwa da suka wajabta gare shi, ko da gaskiyar tuhumar da aka yi mishi.

folded.subject: zaman aure
folded.object: lokacin rabuwarshi
